Database._comentario: Target escolhe a connection string: Remote (sql.bsite.net) ou Express (SQL Server Express local ou numa VM). Na VM, defina ConnectionStrings__Express com o login ghost_api (o script infra/sqlserver/windows/instalar-sqlexpress.ps1 grava em %USERPROFILE%/.api_ghost/sqlexpress.txt).
